title: Finland: 32.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €1,426,060 a year
markdown:
# Finland: 32.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €1,426,060 a year

> Closes 32.1 of 65.5 missing patients a year (49%) · €1,426,060 of €5M · €3,573,940 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Reaching the best quarter of counties (30.4%) means 123.1 more patients a year treated to cure; no range is given. [^model] The split between operation and radiotherapy is not available. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 27.0% to 28.1% by 2028: 32.1 more patients a year (range 0.0–48.9), for €1,426,060 a year, about €44,412 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 49% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (65.5 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | County | Funded measures | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Lapland** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €211,500 | 5.2 |
| 2 | **Kymenlaakso** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €185,650 | 4.0 |
| 3 | **Southwest Finland** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €141,330 | 3.4 |
| 4 | **Satakunta** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists | €121,280 | 3.2 |
| 5 | **North Karelia** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital | €146,000 | 3.1 |
| 6 | **Kanta-Häme** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists | €115,840 | 2.9 |
| 7 | **North Ostrobothnia** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €98,500 | 2.5 |
| 8 | **South Savo** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists | €111,920 | 2.4 |
| 9 | **South Karelia** | Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €117,250 | 2.2 |
| 10 | **North Savo** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €61,690 | 1.5 |
| 11 | **Kainuu** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €79,900 | 1.2 |
| 12 | **Central Ostrobothnia** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €27,200 | 0.5 |
| 13 | **Vantaa and Kerava** | Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €8,000 | 0.0 |
| | **Total** | | **€1,426,060** | **32.1 (0.0–48.9)** |

Each county's own plan lists the owner, the first step and the measure for every action. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €17,418,643 a year; modelled to avoid 29.9 deaths a year (6.8–77.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 27.0% (2019–2023, measured) → 28.1% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

€3,573,940 of the €5M budget buys nothing more: the access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland; this plan is modelled to avoid 4.8 of them (range 0.0-14.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are assumptions, not trial results. The range shows the lowest and highest values when all assumptions move together. It is not a probability. [^model]
- The model's comparison is adjusted only for the share of residents aged 65 or over, not for stage, frailty, histology, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured, and is only a secondary view: none of 3 outcomes matched it in the expected direction beyond chance. [^model]

flagged.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model]
flagged.reason: Asserted that these options would yield more, which the source does not state; the source only points to them as places to see what else the money could do. Rewritten to match.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents aged 65 or over, not for stage, frailty, histology, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
flagged.reason: The reported shares are measured, unadjusted values; only the model's comparison adjusts for the share of residents aged 65 or over. Rewritten so the measured shares are not described as adjusted.

flagged.sentence: The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here: none of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]
flagged.reason: The source does not say the clock was dropped because of the failed check. It calls the clock an estimated secondary view and calls the check 'a check, not a validation'. Rewritten so it no longer implies that cause and states that the clock is estimated.

written_sections: What more money buys, and what it cannot
draft_markdown:
## The gap
Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Reaching the best quarter of counties (30.4%) means 123.1 more patients a year treated to cure; no range is given. [^model] The split between operation and radiotherapy is not available. [^model]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot
€3,573,940 of the €5M budget buys nothing more: the access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland; this plan is modelled to avoid 4.8 of them (range 0.0-14.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits
- Effects are assumptions, not trial results. The range shows the lowest and highest values when all assumptions move together. It is not a probability. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents aged 65 or over, not for stage, frailty, histology, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here: none of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]
